mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because its implementation is cleaner.

cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, because its implementation is cleaner. That comes from Muninn record #14 (a user-stated decision), which is still current. I left out the earlier value it replaced.

Record #25 is a later decision, "verification on all builds", which withdraws record #23. It doesn't change the backend choice, so I didn't include it.

The first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead. Muninn also reported a red heartbeat: 8 hooks started and never finished, which suggests a hook is exceeding its timeout. I haven't looked into it.
